notes.title: Controller support and next goals
notes.content:
Dear players!

We are glad to announce that the game now supports different types of controllers—you can connect PlayStation, Xbox, or Nintendo Switch controllers to your PC and enjoy playing the available chapters with them. We have put in the effort to ensure direct navigation for EVERYTHING, including:

[list]
[*] Moving Jase directly with the joystick.
[*] Navigating menus, inventory items, spells, and hotspots using the D-Pad or joystick.
[*] Each minigame has its own custom implementation for a better experience.
[*] For those who enjoy moving the cursor and getting the classic Point-and-Click feel—no worries! You can also use the joystick to move the cursor. Your choice!
[/list]
And of course, we have mapped all the keyboard shortcuts, such as the journal, shapeshift, quick save, and game pause, to gamepad buttons. We even included a new feature to skip cutscenes. :)

[b]The controller support is a crucial milestone for us and will be used on consoles later.[/b]

The game will recognize which controller is connected and will display a dedicated mapping scheme that can be accessed at any time during gameplay. Here’s the control scheme for Xbox:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36089082/1db68953cd13e059409506c2751734dc57471e21.png[/img]

[b]Why are we focusing on other platforms instead of developing Chapter 2?[/b]

In our last update, we mentioned that the game is available on mobile devices, and now we are targeting consoles. As an indie studio working part-time with a tight budget, Chapter 2 is taking more time than we would like. We don't want to compromise by shipping a low-quality product just to say we completed it.
We want to continue the game with the same quality of humor, graphics, puzzles, and everything we've put our effort into so far. To speed up the process, we MUST reach a larger audience, which will eventually help increase our budget. Ultimately, this will assist us in finishing Chapter 2—a milestone we are eager to achieve—as well as the rest of the chapters.

As you can see, we are still working on the game, and we will ship more chapters one way or another. This game will be completed as promised. I hope you understand our position. If not, I can only focus on making the game with passion ♥️🧙‍♂️

Yakir

notes.title: Plot of the Druid: Dev insights & gameplay - AdventureX 2023
notes.content:
[b]Event Information[/b]

Plot of the Druid is part of the AdventureX 2023 Sale from Nov. 3 - Nov. 9. There will be two broadcasts:
[list]
[*] November 8th, 4PM GMT - Dev playthrough with commentary
[*] November 9th , 4PM GMT -  Dev, feat. Nomad1sh Playthrough
[/list]

[b]Dev insights & gameplay[/b]

Join the creator, [b]Yakir Israel[/b], as he plays the game and discusses the inspirations behind the game, behind-the-scenes insights, and more. On November 9th, [b]nomad1sh[/b], will also join to discuss the game's details alongside Yakir.

Nomad1sh is a former streamer and current game developer who travels while doing so. You can find him on IG [url=https://www.instagram.com/nomad1sh_/]https://www.instagram.com/nomad1sh_/[/url]




[b]About Plot of the Druid[/b]

Plot of the Druid is a mystical comedy adventure with sarcastic British wit, hand-drawn cartoon art, and an innovative shape-shifting ability for solving puzzles. It is a classic-modern point-and-click game reminiscent of titles such as Simon the Sorcerer, Discworld, and Harry Potter.

Watch the broadcast on the store page [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1108170/Plot_of_the_Druid/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1108170/Plot_of_the_Druid/[/url]

notes.title: Version 4.3 - Load-Save and scaling bug fix
notes.content:
Version 4.3 include the following fixes:
- Saving after finish prologue and then loading - game being stuck with save prompt and state of the game become messed up
- Saving in potion room then loading, in certain case it's making Jase floating  in the room
- Sometimes when characters ending their animation they're changing their scale\direction for one frame (looks like a glitch)

if these bugs stop you from making progress in chapter 1, you can 
restart the chapter from the main menu.
IN THAT CASE - DO NOT USE YOUR OLD SAVE FILES!

notes.title: Beta tests start in September 24!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36089082/59e9e406f6f75e2644012c90926d24e289adcda1.png[/img]

If you want to be a beta tester that's the time!!
please send me an email to: adventure4lifestudios@gmail.com

The tester's responsibility:
- Detalied report with list of bugs, screenshots, steps to reproduce,
play time measurement, computer spec, overal impression
- Willing to test few times after issues fixed
- Willing to response quickly in the tests period (around 3 weeks)

In the end, your name will appear in the credits (forever!!)

Number of testers per language:
English (6), German(1), Spanish (1), French(1)

For other platforms: Linux (2), Mac (1)

notes.title: FREE DEMO launches October 15!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36089082/64073d8b808ea6e8bd20748a0793832ca51be097.png[/img]

We are excited to announce that [b]Plot of the Druid - Nightwatch[/b] the prologue to the full game, is going to be released this [b]October[/b]!

It's a [b]FREE DEMO[/b], and it features: 
[list]
[*] 1+ hour of gameplay with lots of silly jokes
[*] Many references to classic adventure games
[*] A small taste of magical shapeshifting
[*] Two difficulty levels (like in Curse of Monkey Island)
[*] A journal to help keep you on track
[*] Fully voiced and translated into six languages!
[*] Available on Windows, Mac and Linux   
[/list]

[b]Wishlist [/b]the game and don’t miss the party!
